sources: Runway Gen-4 — explicit subject vs camera vs scene motion separation
_meta.principle: Scene motion = ambient atmosphere that's NOT subject and NOT camera. It's what makes a shot feel alive without breaking continuity. Layer ONE scene-motion fragment behind subject + camera. Don't stack two scene-motion verbs.

dust_motes_in_light.name: Dust Motes in Light
dust_motes_in_light.use: Window-lit scenes, intimate interiors — adds texture without distraction
dust_motes_in_light.fragment: dust motes drift slowly through the shaft of light in the background

soft_breeze_curtain.name: Soft Breeze Curtain
soft_breeze_curtain.use: Window-side product shots — gentle curtain sway adds life
soft_breeze_curtain.fragment: a thin curtain in the background sways gently in a soft breeze

candle_flame_flicker.name: Candle Flame Flicker
candle_flame_flicker.use: Dim warm scenes, mood shots, founder-table vibes
candle_flame_flicker.fragment: a candle flame in the background flickers gently, casting subtle shifting shadows

light_shifts_through_window.name: Light Shifts Through Window
light_shifts_through_window.use: Time-passing feel, subtle drama, golden-hour shots
light_shifts_through_window.fragment: warm light through a window slowly shifts across the scene as if a cloud passes

screen_glow_pulse.name: Screen Glow Pulse
screen_glow_pulse.use: Tech / HR / app shots — screen casts subtle pulsing light onto subject's face
screen_glow_pulse.fragment: soft cyan glow from a nearby screen pulses gently on [SUBJECT]'s face

shadow_drifts.name: Shadow Drifts
shadow_drifts.use: Outdoor or backlit scenes — shadow movement implies time + sun
shadow_drifts.fragment: a soft shadow drifts slowly across the background surface

kitchen_steam_pot.name: Kitchen Steam from Pot
kitchen_steam_pot.use: Cooking scenes — out-of-focus pot adds depth and temperature
kitchen_steam_pot.fragment: in the soft-focus background, steam rises from a pot on the stove

cafe_motion_blur_passersby.name: Café Passersby Motion Blur
cafe_motion_blur_passersby.use: Urban / lifestyle scenes — out-of-focus people walking past
cafe_motion_blur_passersby.fragment: in the soft-focus background, blurred passersby move past slowly

reflections_on_surface.name: Reflections on Surface
reflections_on_surface.use: Polished products on glass/metal — subtle reflection life
reflections_on_surface.fragment: subtle ambient reflections shift on the glossy surface beneath [SUBJECT]
